The prior AI-17 planner-specialist acceptance on candidate `cef75a385929e09c35915c2cc323cdb847aa4eff` failed with `model_pricing_stale_or_unverified` before reservation or provider invocation; read-only accounting showed zero provider calls and `$0` spend. Sources: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.6-luna, /gpt-5.6-terra, /gpt-5.6-sol, and https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing.
